---
applyTo: "projects/**/*.tsx,engines/remotion-starter/**/*.tsx"
---
Remotion compositions: motion from `useCurrentFrame()` with `spring()`/`interpolate()` (clamped), media via `staticFile()`, `random(seed)` instead of `Math.random()`, timing with `<Sequence>`/`<Series>`. Personal use only. Full rules are in `AGENTS.md`.
